description: Creates a new Sentry project for an existing organization and team, allowing configuration of its name, slug, platform, and default alert rules.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for creating a new project associated with a specific team within a Sentry organization.

default_rules.description: Specifies whether to create default alert rules. If true (API default when parameter is omitted), an alert is triggered for every new issue. If false, no default alerts are created.
default_rules.title: Default Rules

name.description: Display name for the new Sentry project.
name.title: Name

organization_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry organization where the project will be created.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

platform.description: Primary platform or language (e.g., python, javascript, java) for SDK setup instructions and issue processing.
platform.title: Platform

slug.description: Optional unique identifier for the project (e.g., for URLs), auto-generated from the name if omitted. Pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_\-]*$`.
slug.title: Slug

team_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry team to associate with the project.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: CreateTeamProjectForOrganizationRequest

name: create_team_project_for_organization

CreateTeamProjectForOrganizationResponse.description: Response schema for `CreateTeamProjectForOrganization`, containing details of the newly created project.

access.description: List of access scopes/permissions the current user has for this project (e.g., 'project:read', 'project:write', 'event:admin').
access.title: Access

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the project was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

environments.description: List of environment names configured for the project (e.g., 'production', 'staging').
environments.title: Environments

features.description: List of enabled features for the project (e.g., 'similarity-indexing', 'alert-filters').
features.title: Features

firstEvent.description: Timestamp of the first event received by the project, or null if no events yet.
firstEvent.title: First Event

firstTransactionEvent.description: Whether the project has received a transaction event.
firstTransactionEvent.title: First Transaction Event

hasAccess.description: Whether the current user has access to this project.
hasAccess.title: Has Access

hasFeedbacks.description: Whether the project has user feedback data.
hasFeedbacks.title: Has Feedbacks

hasFlags.description: Whether the project has feature flags data.
hasFlags.title: Has Flags

hasMonitors.description: Whether the project has monitoring/cron check-ins configured.
hasMonitors.title: Has Monitors

hasProfiles.description: Whether the project has profiling data.
hasProfiles.title: Has Profiles

hasReplays.description: Whether the project has session replay data.
hasReplays.title: Has Replays

hasSessions.description: Whether the project has session data.
hasSessions.title: Has Sessions

id.description: Unique identifier of the newly created project.
id.title: Id

isBookmarked.description: Whether the project is bookmarked by the current user.
isBookmarked.title: Is Bookmarked

isMember.description: Whether the current user is a member of this project.
isMember.title: Is Member

latestDeploys.description: Details of the latest deployments to this project, or null if no deployments.
latestDeploys.title: Latest Deploys

latestRelease.description: Details of the latest release deployed to this project, or null if no releases.
latestRelease.title: Latest Release

platform.description: Primary platform or language configured for the project (e.g., python, javascript-react).
platform.title: Platform

platforms.description: List of all platforms detected in the project's events.
platforms.title: Platforms

team.description: Primary team associated with the project.
team.title: Team

teams.description: All teams associated with the project.
teams.title: Teams

CreateTeamProjectForOrganizationResponse.title: CreateTeamProjectForOrganizationResponse

TeamInfo.description: Information about a team associated with the project.
TeamInfo.title: TeamInfo
